monad_abilities.notes: Adds one-half Nanite Volume (+3 boxes at NV 6) to Condition Monitors (+2 Physical, +1 Stun), and shifts all Wound Modifiers down by one level.

monad_abilities.notes: Minor or Major Action: roll NV test (6 dice) to reduce Condition Monitor damage boxes by hits (Major Action heals double hits and grants +1 situational Edge).

monad_abilities.effect: Minor Action: WIL + NV test to remain conscious and active when physical or stun condition monitors are full.
monad_abilities.notes: Minor Action: WIL + NV test to remain conscious and active when physical or stun condition monitors are full.

dynamic_features.name: Dynamic Features
dynamic_features.effect: Dynamically shifts epidermal pigmentation, melanin, hair follicles, and subcutaneous facial geometry on command. 1 NV: Cosmetic alterations; 2 NV: Full facial reconstruction (+1 Edge on Disguise); 3 NV: Real-time biometric identity mimicry (+2 Edge on Disguise/Impersonation).

stat_effects.notes: Cosmetic to full facial shift (+1 to +2 Edge on disguise)

neuromuscular_amplifier.name: Neuromuscular Amplifier
neuromuscular_amplifier.effect: Reinforces skeletal myofibrils and strike vectors through micro-hydraulic nanite lattice networks. Requires at least 2 NV to form the colony, but additional NV (up to 4+ NV) can be assigned for overdriving or enhanced strike amplification. Grants +1 Melee DV to all unarmed and physical strikes (synergizes with Iron Limbs, Bone Density R4, and Toughskin Spines for 10P Flying Kick).

stat_effects.notes: +1 DV to all melee/unarmed attacks (min 2 NV; overdriving capable)

bio_response_override.name: Bio-Response Override
bio_response_override.effect: Single pre-bought dose colony requiring 3 NV from the nanohive to sustain (dies in 1 week without hive maintenance). Suppresses nociceptors and autonomous shock reactions while stabilizing neurochemical homeostasis. Grants +1 Willpower (buffing Composure, Judge Intentions, Memory, and Living Persona Firewall) and adds +1 box to the Stun Condition Monitor.

stat_effects.notes: +1 Willpower, +1 Stun Condition box (requires 3 NV to sustain)

neurochemical_regulator.name: Neurochemical Regulator
neurochemical_regulator.effect: Single pre-bought dose colony requiring 2 NV from the nanohive to sustain (dies in 1 week without hive maintenance). Modulates endocrine flows, suppressing erratic micro-expressions and voice stress while enhancing charisma projecting. Grants +1 Charisma on social interactions and composure tests.

stat_effects.notes: +1 Charisma on social and composure tests (requires 2 NV to sustain)

neocortical_neural_amp.name: Neocortical Neural Amp
neocortical_neural_amp.effect: Single pre-bought dose colony requiring 2 NV from the nanohive to sustain (dies in 1 week without hive maintenance). Accelerates synaptic transmission across neocortical columns. Grants +1 dice pool bonus to all Logic-linked skill tests (Biotech, Cracking, Electronics, Engineering). Stacks with Math SPU Edge cost reductions.

stat_effects.notes: +1 on all Logic skill tests (requires 2 NV to sustain)

limbic_neural_amp.name: Limbic Neural Amp
limbic_neural_amp.effect: Single pre-bought dose colony requiring 2 NV from the nanohive to sustain (dies in 1 week without hive maintenance). Sharpens amygdala and hippocampal sensory processing pathways. Grants +1 dice pool bonus to all Intuition-linked skill tests (Perception, Stealth, Tracking).

stat_effects.notes: +1 on all Intuition skill tests (requires 2 NV to sustain)

neural_pattern_reinforcement.name: Neural Pattern Reinforcement
neural_pattern_reinforcement.effect: Single pre-bought dose colony requiring 2 NV from the nanohive to sustain (dies in 1 week without hive maintenance). Hardens motor cortex engrams and neuromuscular kinesthetic pathways. Grants +1 dice pool bonus to all Agility-linked skill tests (Athletics, Close Combat, Firearms).

stat_effects.notes: +1 on all Agility skill tests (requires 2 NV to sustain)

tech_infestation.name: Tech Infestation
tech_infestation.effect: Nanites extrude through dermal contact points into target electronic, commlink, or cyberware hardware circuitry. Provides physical datajack bridging without requiring a cyberware datajack; enables contact hijacking and direct device control.

stat_effects.notes: Direct dermal datajack bridge & contact hijacking without cyberware datajack
